_state.meaning: This file is a runtime-preserved overlay, not a static source of truth. It records which agent cards are currently deployed under aaa.arif-fazil.com/.well-known/. The system (not humans) refreshes this on every card rotation. Do NOT edit to declare deployment — re-issue the card and update its signed canonical_sha256.
_state.schema_intent: Companion to /.well-known/agent-card.json. Identifies the deployed card, version, signature, and explicitly excludes internal-only card locations.

public_agent_card.name: AAA A2A Gateway
public_agent_card.editing_invariant: Any field edit invalidates the Ed25519 signature. To update, re-sign and bump canonical_sha256.
